definition.name: Captured Java dependency native programme (${{ matrix.mode }})

steps.name: Prepare pinned native Java tools and compiler namespaces
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
python3 -m pip install --requirement tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_java_dependency_suite
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap protobuf-compiler pkg-config libssl-dev
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
curl --fail --location --retry 3 --max-time 180 \
  https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-9.1.0-bin.zip \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/dependency-gradle.zip"
echo "a17ddd85a26b6a7f5ddb71ff8b05fc5104c0202c6e64782429790c933686c806  $RUNNER_TEMP/dependency-gradle.zip" | sha256sum --check --strict
unzip -q "$RUNNER_TEMP/dependency-gradle.zip" -d "$RUNNER_TEMP"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/gradle-9.1.0/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 \
  https://github.com/WebAssembly/wasi-sdk/releases/download/wasi-sdk-29/wasi-sdk-29.0-x86_64-linux.tar.gz \
  -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/dependency-wasi-sdk.tar.gz"
echo "87d1d1a2879d139cdc624b968efad3d4a97b8078cdff95e63ac88ecafd1a0171  $RUNNER_TEMP/dependency-wasi-sdk.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/dependency-wasi-sdk.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
python3 tools/install_guest_bindgen.py "$RUNNER_TEMP/dependency-bindgen"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/dependency-bindgen" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
